content: For an electromagnetic wave travelling in free space, the relation between average energy densities due to electric (U<sub>e</sub>) and magnetic (U<sub>m</sub>) fields is :

explanation: In EMW, average energy density due to electric field (U<sub>e</sub>) and magnetic field (U<sub>m</sub>) is same.
